title: agent-team-evals run record
description: One line of results/*.jsonl = one run of one config on one task (one repetition). Usage is the primary metric: tokens, turns, wall time. api_equiv_usd is an API-price yardstick for comparing configs, not a charge. Schema version 2 renamed cost_usd to api_equiv_usd and budget_usd to cap_api_equiv_usd.

schema_version.description: Bump when a field changes meaning.

sweep_id.description: UTC timestamp id shared by every run in one `ate run` call.

model.description: Model alias passed to --model, identical across configs.

dry_run.description: True = no API calls were made; usage is zero.

status.description: passed/failed come from hidden tests. cap_exceeded/timeout/agent_error mean the pipeline stopped early (still graded; a fail if tests fail). rate_limited/auth_error/harness_error say nothing about the config: they are excluded from statistics and re-run by `ate run --resume`.

passed.description: Every hidden test passed. The headline metric.

tests.description: Hidden-test counts; passed/total is the partial-credit score.

api_equiv_usd.description: What this run would cost at API prices (sum of Claude Code's total_cost_usd per stage). A yardstick for comparing configs. On a subscription nothing is charged.

tokens.description: Primary usage metric. Summed over stages: input, output, cache_read, cache_creation.

agent_wall_s.description: Primary usage metric. Wall-clock seconds in agent stages (excludes setup and grading).

num_turns.description: Primary usage metric. Summed agentic turns over all stages.

stages.description: Per-stage detail: name, agent, api_equiv_usd, tokens, num_turns, duration_s, subtype, is_error, exit_code, structured, command.

review_verdict.description: APPROVE / CHANGES_NEEDED / null when the config has no reviewer or it failed to answer.

fix_round.description: Whether the one allowed fix stage ran.

diff.description: Size of the agents' change vs the seed commit.

touched_tests.description: Agents changed files under tests/ (expected: they add tests).

read_only_violations.description: Read-only stages that changed files (the harness reverted them).

leak_suspected.description: Suspicious strings (hidden-test or solution paths) found in transcripts.

harness_sha.description: git HEAD of this repo when the run started.

cap_api_equiv_usd.description: Runaway-loop cap for this run in API-equivalent dollars (stages share it). Not a spending limit.

attempt.description: 1 unless --resume re-ran this (task, config, rep) after a retryable status.

questions_asked.description: Only on tasks with the ask_user tool: how many times the agents called it (all stages).

questions.description: Only on ask_user tasks: one {stage, question, answer, matched} per call. matched is the answer-sheet entry id, or null when the default answer was given.

isolation_flags.description: Signs the personal Claude setup leaked in (CLAUDE.md canary, plugins or MCP servers loaded).
